page.overview:
What is Hish-qu-Ten?

The Hish-qu-Ten ("The People Who Take Territory"), commonly referred to as simply the Hish, are the ancient ancestors of the species. They were generally smaller and more animalistic.

The human naturalist Dr. Maya Bergstrom theorized that the Yautja (and by extension, the Hish-qu-Ten) had evolved from Earthern dicynodont-derived ancestors, the prehistoric stem-mammals having been possibly taken offworld by an unknown spacefaring species and allowed to thrive on a new world (likely Yautja Prime).

Over hundreds of millions of years, these dicynodonts evolved into a knuckle-walking ape-like form, which itself eventually further evolved into the Hish, its tusks developing into their characteristic mandibles.

The Hish were a technologically primitive civilization and ancient ancestors to the Yautja. At some point, they were completely subjugated by the advanced alien race known as the Amengi and enslaved for several centuries, living in miserable conditions under their rulers. The Hish were farmed for food, used as slave labor, experimental guinea pigs, and eventually entertainment in the form of sport hunting and gladiatorial combat.
